definitionZh: 边框-block-start-style CSS属性定义了元素逻辑块起始边框的样式,根据元素的书写模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将它映射到物理边框样式. 它与边框-顶部风格,边框-右部风格,边框-下部风格,或边框-左部风格的属性相对应,取决于为写法模式,方向,以及文字导向定义的值.
sourceDefinition: The border-block-start-style CSS property defines the style of the logical block start border of an element, which maps to a physical border style depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-style, border-right-style, border-bottom-style, or border-left-style property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
